objective.outcome: Governed pull-request resume publishes the already reviewed ticket HEAD without mutating unrelated files or depending on a free local canonical branch name.
nonGoals: Do not weaken exact-ticket, clean-tree, ancestry or post-test revalidation checks.
Do not delete, reset or overwrite local branches or worktrees.
Do not change version, release, registry, direct-main or publish-only behavior.
constraints: Keep the repair within two internal delivery components and four implementation/test files.
Preserve README.md, dependency carriers and every human-owned ticket file.
Use a non-forced explicit remote refspec for the canonical PR head.

findings.summary: Committed-candidate resume runs mutation-capable bootstrap before candidate classification and can admit an unrelated README badge commit.

evidence.observation: PR #87 first published commit db057409 after bootstrap refreshed README.md outside ticket-053 allowedPaths.

requiredSignals: Delivery mode is pull-request and clean HEAD is ahead of the authoritative base in an exact-ticket commit range.
excludedSignals: The working tree already contains uncommitted user or implementation changes.

findings.desiredOutcome: Classify and retest the immutable committed candidate before bootstrap, and suppress Goal-owned cost badge refresh in ordinary PR delivery.

findings.summary: PR publication fails after tests when a merged local canonical branch alias still exists.

evidence.observation: Ticket-053 closure commit 1a2e262 passed 600 tests, then git switch -c failed because goal/ticket-053 already existed locally.

requiredSignals: Current reviewed HEAD must be published to a canonical remote goal/ticket-NNN branch.
excludedSignals: The remote canonical branch requires a non-fast-forward update.

findings.desiredOutcome: Push current HEAD to the canonical remote ref without changing or deleting any local branch alias.

actions.description: Move exact committed-candidate classification ahead of bootstrap and isolate Goal-owned badge mutation in pull-request mode.
Replace local canonical branch creation with a non-forced explicit HEAD-to-remote refspec.
Add regression coverage for ordering, badge isolation, candidate revalidation, local alias preservation and explicit remote ref publication.

verifications.expected: A committed candidate resumes before bootstrap; ordinary PR delivery suppresses cost badge refresh and revalidates governance before staging.
A colliding local branch is preserved while reviewed HEAD is pushed non-forced to the canonical remote ref.
All ordering, scope, branch-collision and fail-closed regressions pass.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Committed-candidate resume and ordinary pull-request preparation cannot create an unrelated badge change or bypass post-bootstrap governance.
Canonical remote PR publication succeeds without modifying a colliding local branch and without using force.

llmGuidance.role: Plan a bounded internal refactoring; do not implement, widen scope or approve it.
mustPreserve: Exact-ticket candidate binding, authoritative base ancestry and post-test revalidation.
Non-forced remote updates and all local branches/worktrees.
forbiddenAssumptions: Do not assume a local canonical branch is disposable because its PR was merged.
Do not assume bootstrap-generated changes are inside the active ticket scope.
Do not treat LLM or todo2code output as merge authority.
